verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a memory-layer service and CLI, but the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting, environment variable, or policy. Self-hosting to keep data on your own infrastructure (honcho-docs-9) is an adjacent deployment option, not a telemetry control. The off-by-default Dreamer features (honcho-docs-23) are unrelated product features, so neither earns credit.
